opening.argument: The title makes an unqualified promise that the Sniper Bot will make viewers millionaires, while the description directs them to download it through an external link. The displayed software is tied to a wallet-based trading flow: it includes a private_key field alongside wallet settings, and offers Buy Token, Sell Token, Approve Token, and balance-targeting functions. Those observable features connect the promoted download to control over wallet and asset operations. Nothing supplied establishes that the millionaire promise is reliable or that download recipients achieve such results, so the promotion rests on an unsupported returns claim attached to a wallet-integrated trading bot.

citations.quote: Sniper Bot will make you a millionaire
